output.summary: The 95% green dashboard is unreliable. Status is self-reported, with no objective criteria. Green share rose from 64% to over 90% after the Nov 2025 memo and the 2026 percent-green bonus. Audit, escalation log and staff accounts show hidden slippage. CSD's own late, incomplete Platform requests (58% returned) drive most delays. Complete, early requests are delivered 87% of the time. Platform's 2026 capacity shortfall is real but secondary. Whether the SVP knowingly directed green-shifting is unestablished. Pursue objective status criteria and a Customer Success-based metric. Reject the transfer and SLA request, deanonymising survey authors, and removing the SVP now. A hiring-freeze exception is reasonable but not urgent.
